mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real GDP signals a demand shock that will negatively impact corporate earnings and equity valuations, driving S&P 500 returns lower over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances following a GDPC1 YoY growth print below 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating rise in industrial production signals strengthening economic activity that will boost corporate revenues and drive S&P 500 returns higher over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher following accelerating INDPRO growth (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A rapid decline in the unemployment rate signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation and pressure corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances following a rapid 0.5pp UNRATE decline.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp spike in the federal funds rate signals a monetary tightening shock that will negatively impact equity valuations and drive S&P 500 returns lower over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances following a sharp FEDFUNDS spike.

mechanism_narrative: A collapse in retail sales signals a severe demand shock that will drive S&P 500 returns lower over the next 60 trading days, especially if accompanied by a rise in unemployment.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances following a RSAFS collapse, or if UNRATE is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts signals a strengthening construction sector that will boost economic activity and drive S&P 500 returns higher over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher following a HOUST surge (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating rise in payroll employment signals a strengthening labor market that will boost consumer spending and drive S&P 500 returns higher over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher following accelerating PAYEMS growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the consumer price index signals building inflationary pressures that will erode real equity returns and drive S&P 500 nominal returns lower over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX nominal 60-day returns are not significantly lower following a sustained CPIAUCSL rise above 3% YoY (t-test p > 0.1).
